universe: Union of historical NSE cash-market identities; never today's survivors or the app's 100-stock sample

datasets.prices: Raw daily OHLCV, rupee turnover, dated symbol/ISIN/series; preserve EQ/BE/BZ/SM/ST/SZ observations
datasets.indices: Official daily benchmark and VIX levels; no ETF or realised-volatility substitution
datasets.calendar: Official open/closed sessions including exceptional Saturday/Sunday sessions
datasets.identity: Dated issuer IDs, security types, listing/delisting and symbol/ISIN changes; distinguish ETFs, equities, rights, REITs
datasets.actions: Verified splits, bonuses, dividends, mergers/demergers; ex-date and original announcement timestamp
datasets.financials: Original and revised quarterly/annual facts with filing timestamp, period identity, scope and XBRL evidence
datasets.shareholding: Dated promoter holding, promoter pledge and outstanding equity shares, original XBRL evidence
datasets.membership: Historical Nifty 50/500 and regime-universe membership intervals
datasets.surveillance: Historical ASM/GSM/trading-status intervals, explicit no-surveillance coverage
datasets.earnings: Announced results/board-meeting dates and original announcement times; retain cancellations
datasets.costs: Dated taxes, exchange/SEBI/GST/DP fees and explicit execution/slippage assumptions

notes: S1-S9 describe the price-only source specification. Enabling full PMS filters adds financials, shareholding, sectors, membership, surveillance and earnings.
Indicators, breadth, relative strength and weekly bars are derived locally from dated inputs, not downloaded as independent facts.
Strategy performance claims in the supplied specification are unverified; this catalogue does not certify them.
Each ETF joins only after its actual listing and required lookback; never backfill a pre-launch ETF with an index.
